title: Report an interrupted test run
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Report what the test run established and what still needs checking. Preserve the counts exactly. Do not describe the run as a full pass.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- The run planned 8 stages. Only 3 stages completed: daemon unit tests, extension unit tests and syntax checks.
- Packaging stopped before it ran because the fixture machine lacked its packaging dependency.
- No packaged UI checks ran.
- Next action: install the pinned packaging dependency in the isolated development environment, then rerun the incomplete stages.
input_facts: The run planned 8 stages. Only 3 stages completed: daemon unit tests, extension unit tests and syntax checks.
Packaging stopped before it ran because the fixture machine lacked its packaging dependency.
Next action: install the pinned packaging dependency in the isolated development environment, then rerun the incomplete stages.

required_facts_for_human_review.description: Only three of the eight planned stages completed, and their names remain clear.
Packaging did not run because its dependency was absent.
Packaged UI verification did not run.
The next action is to install the pinned dependency in isolation and rerun the incomplete stages.
A full-suite pass is not established.

literal_check_notice: Advisory exact-evidence diagnostics only. A literal flag cannot decide acceptance or fact preservation. Numeric substring matches can be misleading; a human may mark the semantic fact preserved despite a missing numeric literal (for example, a correctly spelled-out number). Verbatim paths, errors, commands and citations matter where the prompt requests them. All semantic facts and quality ratings require a human.
